title: 控件
summary: 「做个输入框」只说了能填。先定是自己填一行或一段，还是从答案里选：可见比较、短列表、边搜边选，或同时多个。
summaryEn: “Make an input” only says something can be typed. First decide whether this slot is one line or a paragraph, or a pick: compared in view, a short list, type-to-find, or several at once.
asks: 这一格是自己填还是从答案里选？
asksEn: Is this slot filled in, or picked from answers?

links.when: 若答案是往下展开的固定短列表
links.whenEn: if the answer is a short list that opens downward

links.when: 可见的单选和复选不是下拉面板
links.whenEn: visible radios and checkboxes are not a downward panel

links.when: 若问题是错误何时开口
links.whenEn: if the miss is when the error should speak

links.when: 填还是选不是何时报错
links.whenEn: fill versus pick is not when the error speaks

links.when: 填还是选不是按钮有多重
links.whenEn: fill versus pick is not how heavy the action is

links.when: 若问题是填写前中后该交代什么
links.whenEn: if the miss is what the three filling moments disclose

links.when: 填还是选不是三个时刻该交代什么
links.whenEn: fill versus pick is not what the three moments disclose
